data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for realtime location queries using GeoFire and Firebase.
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to store, query and listen to geographic keys in Firebase Realtime Database. It streams updates when keys enter, exit, or move within a radius around a location.
use_when: You need realtime nearby‑place queries backed by Firebase Realtime Database
Your app runs on Android or iOS and can add native pod dependencies
avoid_when: You target web or desktop platforms
You use Cloud Firestore instead of Realtime Database
You need a fully featured mapping UI
strengths: Supports Android and iOS with null safety
weaknesses: Works only with Firebase Realtime Database
data.setup_notes: Add pod 'GeoFire' in iOS Podfile as shown in README; ensure Firebase Realtime Database is configured and rules include .indexOn for 'g' field; Android setup is automatic via plugin.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides location fetching without Firebase dependency and works on all platforms

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Utility library for geographic calculations if you implement your own backend
